title: The Story
paragraphs: nubuilds started from a simple idea: custom PCs should look as good as they perform. What began as a hobby of building rigs for friends quickly grew into something bigger — a commitment to delivering premium, hand-built machines that stand out from anything off the shelf.

Every nubuilds PC is assembled by hand, with meticulous attention to cable management, thermal performance, and aesthetics. From the choice of components to the final power-on, every detail is deliberate.
